title: Mutation Receipt
description: Runtime-authored proof that filesystem mutations under a WriteScopeBinding stayed inside effective_allowed roots (allowed_roots minus denied_roots; deny wins). Prompts are not enforcement. Does not grant further authority.

receipt_id.description: Deterministic id: wmr- + sha256(binding_id + ':' + run_id + ':' + evaluated_at + ':' + compliance)[:24].

base_sha.description: Frozen Approval base_sha at bind time.

changed_paths.description: Repo-relative paths observed as mutated during the bound attempt.

restored_paths.description: Out-of-scope paths Runtime attempted to restore. Not a claim of atomic rollback.

binding_status.description: Terminal (or checkpoint) Binding status recorded on this receipt.

approval_status.description: Approval status after enforcement outcomes (consume / revoke-by-breach / leave reusable).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the receipt object was minted.

evaluated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when compliance was evaluated.

stop_reason.description: Failure/stop reason when the run or authority checkpoint failed closed.

failure_reason.description: Optional non-authoritative detail for breach, expiry, revoke, or restore limits.

effective_allowed_roots.description: Absolute allowed roots used for classification (before deny subtraction at path-check time).

denied_roots.description: Absolute denied roots; deny wins over allowed on path-prefix overlap.

rollback_atomic.description: Always false in v3.3 Wave 4 — do not claim atomic rollback.
